items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids beim Finanzamt Beispielhausen, Am Musterwall 7, 31134 Beispielhausen, schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen oder dort zur Niederschrift zu erklären.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 27 Oct 2025 (posting day). Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a letter sent by simple post counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: 31 Oct 2025. That day is Reformationstag, a public holiday in Niedersachsen, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deemed delivery moves to the next working day, Mon 3 Nov 2025. The one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 AO) starts counting the following day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO) and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the start day, i.e. Wed 3 Dec 2025. That day is a normal business day, so no further shift is needed.

items.title: Refund payout of overpaid income tax
items.quote: Die Auszahlung erfolgt in den nächsten Tagen auf das bekannte Konto.
items.computation: The letter only states the refund will be paid 'in the next few days' to the account on file, without a fixed calendar date. No precise due date can be derived from this wording, so no exact date is set; the amount (767.00 EUR) is stated in the assessment ('Erstattungsbetrag: 767,00 €').

warnings: The refund payout date ('in den nächsten Tagen') is vague and not a fixed calendar date; if the refund does not arrive within a couple of weeks, contact the Finanzamt with the Steuernummer.
